$comment: CANONICAL Familiar theme — single source of truth. Both generators read this file and overlay FAMILIAR_THEME_<ROLE> / FAMILIAR_THEME_ANSI_<NAME>. Palette provenance: gruvbox dark, medium contrast (morhetz). Semantic adaptations: the error role uses gruvbox-material red (#ea6962) instead of bright red (#fb4934), which misses the 4.5:1 contrast floor on bg0; surface levels recess below background (bg0_h, then bg_dim) matching the established Familiar depth model. The tool lifecycle backgrounds (toolPendingBg/toolSuccessBg/toolErrorBg) are restrained 14% tints of gruvbox blue/green/red over bg0 — dark, harmonious surfaces that sit between surface and overlay and keep pending (cool), success (green), and error (red) visually distinct without bright traffic-light blocks. The ANSI palette is authentic gruvbox.
name: familiar-gruvbox
